response.sql:
WITH project_totals AS (
  SELECT
    p.arcregistry AS project_id,
    p.fundflux AS funding_source,
    SUM(ss.boxx) AS total_boxx,
    SUM(ss.boxz) AS total_boxz
  FROM scanspatial AS ss
  JOIN projects AS p
    ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
  GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux
), project_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    project_id,
    funding_source,
    total_boxx / NULLIF(total_boxz, 0) AS ratio
  FROM project_totals
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    project_id,
    funding_source,
    ratio,
    ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS excess
  FROM project_ratios
)
SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, excess
FROM scored
WHERE excess > 0
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Projects with no matching spatial records are excluded; each project's ratio is NULL when its summed boxz is zero or all boxz values are missing, and such ratios are omitted from the funding-source average.
